extras: Warning: Passwords are never stored in plaintext, and data cannot be recovered if forgotten. Encryption methods have not undergone an independent audit.
problem: Users need a way to secure sensitive information, notes, and files directly within their local Obsidian vault, especially when working on mobile devices.
summary: Encrypt text fragments, entire notes, and various files within the Obsidian vault using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2 algorithms.
